name: BLOOD NOTE
source:
An ADV game themed on medieval period fantasy.
A daughter in a noble family is made into a vampire
and takes revenge for it in this relatively savage and bloody story.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205913.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一款以中世纪奇幻为主题的冒险游戏。

贵族家庭的女儿被变成吸血鬼，并在这部相对野蛮、血腥的故事中展开复仇。

（来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE205913.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]）
